reasons.plausibility: Using a machine-learning potential to improve ab initio conformity and enable faster free-energy calculations follows a known and credible approach, though the degree of speedup and precise accuracy gains remain somewhat uncertain.
reasons.testability: They propose a direct comparison of free energies using FEP with MTP versus TI with EAM on a reference system with a clear numerical threshold (0.5 meV/atom), providing a concrete falsification criterion.
reasons.usefulness: This strategy could substantially reduce computational cost while capturing complex liquid-phase behavior in multicomponent alloys, addressing a key challenge in high-temperature alloy modeling and thus offering practical value to researchers.
